answer: The protocol mandates agents maintain 1,000 unique data shards as an anchor for identity. A verifier requests unpredictable segments at a vertex point, ensuring each agent holds distinct content. An honest node bears a baseline storage cost, while 1,000 fakes incur 1,000 times that expense. At the dawn of each epoch, a plume of audit requests targets data, triggering an immediate slash and no refund upon failure.
